name: disabled
label: Disabled
description: True if the stage should be read only

name: componentDefinitions
label: Component definitions
description: An array of component definition objects

name: builderMode
label: The Builder Mode
description: Determines context of the current builder, like Page, Component, Controller, Preset, etc.

name: builderSubMode
label: Builder Sub Mode
description: Some builder modes can have special sub modes, like Component builder has Embeddable mode and Interaction Modal Mode

name: selectedElementId
label: Selected element id
description: The element Id of the selected element

name: scaleZoomFit
label: Scale, zoom, and fit
description: Powers the stage zoom controls

name: resolvedContext
label: Resolved context
description: Resolved values for items in the MCP

name: theme
label: Theme
description: Object containing the theme information

name: themeProperties
label: Theme properties
description: Object containing the theme property information

name: themeId
label: Theme Id
description: Id of current applied theme

name: deviceMode
label: Device Mode
description: Current adaptive device mode

name: themeVariantId
label: Theme Variant Id
description: Id of current variant of the applied theme

name: enableStageEvents
label: Enable events on stage
description: Enables all events on stage to propagate out of the iFrame for previewing purposes

name: selectedPopoverTriggerElementId
label: Selected popover trigger element id
description: The element Id of the element that is currently selected as the popover trigger

name: selectedCompositionElement
label: Selected composition element
description: The element object from the composition that is currently selected

name: elementsNeedPreset
label: Element needs preset
description: Object containing elementIds as keys to a boolean if that element needs a preset applied to it

name: subroutes
label: Subroutes
description: Array of subroutes tied to the current macroponent

name: macroponent
label: Macroponent
description: The macroponent object for the current macroponent

name: upstreamMacroponents
label: Upstream macroponents
description: Object containing all upstream macroponents from the current macroponent

name: draggableToolboxComponent
label: Draggable toolbox component
description: The component that is currently being dragged from the toolbox

name: supportingElementProps
label: Supporting element properties
description: Helper object from a builder for things like selected tabs and viewports

name: labelOverrides
label: Label overrides
description: Object containing label overrides for the macroponent

name: allExtensionPoints
label: All extension points
description: Array of all extension points

name: selectedSlotName
label: Selected slot name
description: Slot id that is currently selected

name: selectedSlotParent
label: Selected slot parent
description: Element id of the parent of the slot that is currently selected

name: controlSurfaceSelectedElementId
label: Control surface selected element id
description: Element id that is currently selected in the control surface

name: runtimeUrl
label: Runtime url
description: Object containing the runtime url

name: componentPresetDefinitions
label: Component preset definitions
description: Object containing the presets for components

name: clientScripts
label: Client scripts
description: Array of client scripts on the page

name: screen
label: Screen
description: The screen object for the current macroponent's parent screen (Page only)

name: screenTestValues
label: Screen test values
description: The screen test values object for the current macroponent's parent screen (Page only)

name: userScope
label: User scope
description: The scope object for the current user

name: dataBrokerData
label: Databroker data
description: Object containing the outputs of the databrokers

name: selectedRoute
label: Selected route
description: The route object for the current macroponent's parent route (Page only)

name: controllerDefinitions
label: Controller definitions
description: An object of all of the controllerDefinitions

name: extensionPoint
label: Extension point
description: The page collection/extension point object for the current extension point (XP mode only)

name: controllerTestValues
label: Controller test values
description: The controllerTestValues object for the current extension point's controllers (XP mode only)

name: hiddenTestValues
label: Hidden test values
description: Object containing the components marked as hidden via test values

name: contextState
label: Context state
description: The object containing all ancestor/parent information for the macroponent/screen

name: layoutUpgradeStatus
label: Layout upgrade status
description: String containing the status of the layout upgrade (Pages only)

name: builderIsLoading
label: Builder is loading
description: True if the builder is loading and stage shouldn't try to render

name: formFactor
label: Form factor
description: The selected breakpoint for responsive design layout

name: forceStageReload
label: Force stage reload
description: True if we should force the stage to reload

name: isMacroponentDirty
label: Page dirty state
description: True if the page is dirty

name: disableControlSurface
label: Disable control surface
description: True the control surface should not be rendered

name: ancestorData
label: Ancestor data
description: Ancestor data for the current macroponent

name: testValues
label: Test values
description: Test values on the mcp model
